summary.content:
Today's selection covers 48 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 33 on Artificial Intelligence and 9 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: UK Institute Is Hunting for Dangers Lurking in AI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Former US execs plead guilty to aiding tech support scammers
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, scams, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 6 articles published in the last 24 hours
